title: Build a complete CRUD REST API for a resource (e.g., Employee) — controller, service, repository, and DTO mapping
hint: Layer a @RestController over a @Service and a JpaRepository, mapping entities to DTOs and returning proper HTTP statuses with ResponseEntity.

title: Add pagination and sorting to a list endpoint using Spring Data's Pageable
hint: Accept a Pageable parameter in the controller or build PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort), and have the repository return Page<T>.

title: Add request validation with @Valid/Bean Validation annotations, and a @ControllerAdvice that returns structured error responses
hint: Annotate request DTO fields with constraints, use @Valid on the parameter, and handle MethodArgumentNotValidException in a @RestControllerAdvice.

title: Implement JWT-based authentication for the API — token generation on login, and a filter that validates the token on each request
hint: Generate a signed token on successful login, then add a OncePerRequestFilter that validates it and sets the Authentication in SecurityContextHolder.

title: Add caching to a read-heavy endpoint using @Cacheable/@CacheEvict, backed by Redis
hint: Enable caching with @EnableCaching, configure RedisCacheManager with a TTL, and use @Cacheable on reads and @CacheEvict on updates and deletes.

title: Wrap a multi-step service operation in a @Transactional method, and demonstrate what happens on partial failure and rollback
hint: Annotate the service method with @Transactional, throw a RuntimeException mid-way to see rollback, and note checked exceptions need rollbackFor.

title: Build a dynamic search/filter endpoint using JPA Specifications, combining multiple optional filter criteria
hint: Implement JpaSpecificationExecutor and build Specification objects per optional filter, composing non-null ones with Specification.where().and().

title: Design and implement an idempotent POST /payments endpoint using an idempotency key stored in Redis or the database
hint: Require an Idempotency-Key header, store the key with the response using an atomic insert or Redis SETNX, and return the stored response on replays.

title: Implement a global exception handler that returns RFC 7807 Problem Details with a correlation ID
hint: Use @RestControllerAdvice returning ProblemDetail with type, title, status and detail, adding the correlation ID from MDC or the request header as a property.

title: Implement JWT validation in a Spring Security filter chain with role-based method security
hint: Register a custom JWT filter in SecurityFilterChain before UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter, enable @EnableMethodSecurity and use @PreAuthorize("hasRole(...)").

title: Implement a WebClient call with timeout, retry with backoff, and error mapping
hint: Chain timeout(), retryWhen(Retry.backoff(...)) and onStatus() to map error responses to custom exceptions on the WebClient call.

title: Add a correlation-ID filter that populates MDC and propagates the ID through Feign or WebClient calls
hint: Write a OncePerRequestFilter that reads or generates the ID, puts it in MDC and clears it in finally; add a Feign RequestInterceptor or WebClient filter to forward it.
